  | description = To celebrate the fifth anniversary of Dungeons and Dragons Online, you have been invited to a pirate-themed parrrrty at [[Smuggler's Rest]]. To get there, find [[Sailor Calatin]] in [[Stormreach Harbor]] during the Euphonia's Treasure Challenge event. Once in Smuggler's Rest find Euphonia Teles and place this invitation in her Hat Box for a special birthday hat!
  | notes       = This was a voucher given to characters created prior to February 22, 2011 as part of DDO's 5th anniversary and the release of the [[Treasure of Crystal Cove]] that could be redeemed at the [[Euphonia's Hat Box]] for a free [[Treasure of Crystal Cove#Pirate Hat|Pirate Hat]]. Hat colors will vary but can be bartered for a different color.

Characters without the party invitation can purchase similar hats in the hat box for [[Doubloon]]s (BtC) or [[DDO Store]] (BtA) for [[DDO Point]]s.

Which hat a character receives is based on the amount of time a character has played DDO:
* Tier 1: {{Item|Swabby's Kerchief}} - a simple Bandana
* Tier 2: {{Item|Freebooter's Bandana}} - a Striped Bandana
* Tier 3: {{Item|Corsair's Skullcap}} - a Striped Bandana with Skull Brooch
* Tier 4: {{Item|Captain's Chapeau}} - a Feathered Hat
* Tier 5: {{Item|Admiral's Tricorne}} - an Admiral's Hat
* Tier 6: {{Item|Dread Admiral's Tricorne}} - an Admiral's Hat with Skull Brooch

Each character's gift is elevated by one tier for each of the following conditions:
* Character has True Reincarnated one or more times: +1 Tier
* Active [[VIP]] Subscription: +1 Tier
* [[Founder]] Account: +1 Tier

The looks of the hats vary by tier, and the base Scallawag's Luck bonus varies by tier (for example, the Tier 6 Dread Admiral's Tricorne comes with "Scallawag's Luck VI: While in Smuggler's Rest, you gain 35% additional doubloons when fighting pirates.") Besides looks and the level of doubloon luck bonus, the hats are all upgradable in the same way, and to the same values.
